COMPUTER STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: COMPUTER STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. International Cricket Team

2. When learning Input/Output Devices, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Input/Output Devices.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Input/Output Devices.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Input/Output Devices.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Input/Output Devices.

3. When learning Evolution and Development of Computers, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Evolution and Development of Computers.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Evolution and Development of Computers.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Evolution and Development of Computers.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Evolution and Development of Computers.

4. When learning Computer Organisation and Architecture, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Computer Organisation and Architecture.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Organisation and Architecture.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Organisation and Architecture.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Organisation and Architecture.

5. When learning Data communication, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Data communication.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data communication.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data communication.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data communication.

6. When learning Computer storage, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer storage.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer storage.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Computer storage.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer storage.

7. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Speaker
   C. Monitor
   D. Keyboard

8. When learning Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4.

9. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Remove all guards

10. When learning Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s.

11. When learning Computer set up, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer set up.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer set up.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Computer set up.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer set up.

12. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Ignore burnt cables

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Program Development Overview and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Identifiers and Operators and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Control Structures 3.5 Data Structures 3.6 Functions Page 15 of 72 1 STRAND 1.0: and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Control Structures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
